text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's run feels like a<n>herald of what's to
come.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
There's something about that one,<n>yeah? She's a
bit rough around the<n>edges, but she's got a head of
steam<n>for sure. I'll have to keep an eye on<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha! That's it! Spread the<n>word! Revel at
the skills of Wicked<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Keheheh... Everybody's watching me.<n>I'm gonna
be all over the news, just<n>watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrr... Why am I only in this tiny<n>"Rookies to
Watch" column?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And they picked a random corner of<n>this magazine
that nobody'll even<n>notice!
choice_data_list: That's a small picture, all right...
That's a small picture, all right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, only one racing magazine<n>chose to cover
her. This probably<n>stings for the attention-loving
Windy,<n>but it's what's to be expected for a<n>runner
who's only just made her<n>debut.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... I'm really ticked off. It<n>wasn't supposed
to be like this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I ran hard enough to make my legs<n>throb, too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? It's nothing a little sleep won't<n>fix.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The real issue here is how no one's<n>giving me the
attention I deserve!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The next race I run in has<n>gotta be a big
one.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I need to show the whole world how<n>awesome I
am!
choice_data_list: Let's drop by the infirmary first.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has some lingering<n>fatigue from the
race. Don't worry,<n>it's not bad enough to require a
hospital visit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, I just need to sleep it off.<n>Stop getting
so worked up over<n>nothing.
choice_data_list: No. This is a sign we can't ignore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy only just became<n>race-ready.
Pushing her legs too<n>much now could hamper her
progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A young Umamusume has to be<n>careful about her
legs during her<n>period of growth. Work too hard and
she may suffer from bucked shins.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bucked shins?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Th-the heck is that? Are my shins<n>gonna be okay?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr! I'm no good with pain!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...I just made my debut, and I already<n>have to stop
running?!
choice_data_list: Not if we act in moderation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain how much damage<n>overworking can do
and that we<n>should wait a while before entering
bigger races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, we can't completely stop<n>racing, either.
We should just take<n>baby steps for the time being.
choice_data_list:
Let's build up your fan base as we get your legs
into the swing of things!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My fan base?
choice_data_list: Yes. We need to get your name out there first!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You mean get me some street cred?!<n>Oh, of course!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's why hardly no one wrote<n>about me after my
debut, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I totally heard<n>people
talking about me, like, "Whoa,<n>she's awesome,"
and all that. But no<n>one ever said my actual name.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! I gotta get the name<n>Windy out there
and turn 'em into my<n>fans.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I've gotta show 'em<n>what real
racing looks like, right?<n>Make 'em all go "Whoooa!"
right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Not a bad strategy, Lackey—or should<n>I say...
Diabolical Strategist! Ya did<n>good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Soon, every magazine,<n>every news
show... heck, everyone<n>and their mom's gonna be
talking<n>about me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've successfully convinced her to<n>take it slow and
easy while she<n>gradually builds both her strength
and<n>her fanbase!
